name: David Crockett State Park - Campground 1
waterfront_evidence: creekside, sites 22-25 only (2026-11-24): the reservation site's own photos of sites 22, 23, 24 and 25 (reserve.tnstateparks.com/david-crockett/campsites, site details) show each gravel pad with its picnic table ending at a wooden rail on a short bank with Shoal Creek's open water a few metres beyond; 3DEP lidar transects east from the pads: site 24 (35.24754,-87.34784) pad ~242.6 m, water surface 240.6 m from ~17 m to ~31 m out, a ~2 m drop over ~9 m (~20%); site 22 water from ~14-18 m (2.3 m drop); site 25 water from ~9 m. Channel ~15 m wide, under 30 m, so creekside, not riverfront; an easy walk down. Official campground map (https://tnstateparks.com/sites/default/files/2025-10/David_Crockett_Campground_web.png) draws 22-25 between the loop road and the creek with nothing between. Esri World Imagery z17/z18 (rendered) shows the creek under a continuous tree strip east of the pads (canopy-blind, no veto). Not counted: 26-27 (wooded, no water in their photos), 13-21 (outer loop, photos show a stone wall and the far bluff, no water), the rest inside the loop.
inclusion_evidence: https://tnstateparks.com/parks/david-crockett/camping (read 2026-11-24): 'Campground #1 sits along Shoal Creek and is open March 1 - November 3.'; 'Campground 1 has 32 campsites with 30-amp electric and 12 campsites with 20-30-50 amp electric.'; reserve.tnstateparks.com/david-crockett/campsites: 44 bookable drive-in sites (1-45, no site 29), drive lengths 25-70 ft, water at every site, four pull-throughs -> real drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits
note: Campground 1 lies on Shoal Creek, about 1.7 km east of Campground 2. Sites 22-25 are pull-throughs on the creek bank, behind a wooden rail; the 50-amp sites are 22-28 and 30-34, the rest 30-amp. --Claude

season.note: The park page gives March 1 - November 3, but the reservation calendar sells Campground 1 nights through November 30 (2026) and again from March 1 (2027).

fees.note: $32 a night on weeknights and $34 on weekends at the 30-amp sites 1-16 and 35-45 through June 2027, then $36 every night; $38-48 at sites 17-28 and 30-34. Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day weekends $52 at sites 1-16 and 35-45, up to $65 at the others.
